newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices up on overseas demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices up on overseas demand.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices rose on demand from overseas buyers at the weekly auction on Tuesday, brokers said.

Brokers said buyers for Poland and Russia were active in bidding and lifted mostly better liquoring large and bold brokens teas. Smaller brokens and fannings teas attracted buyers for Pakistan and Afghanistan, and local blenders, they said.
The average price was 58.80 taka per kg, up 1.05 taka from the previous sale. Some 858,358 kg of teas were sold at the auction. The next sale will be held on July 8 with an offer of 1.14 million kg.
